name: dsh-docchain
description: DSH knowledge base and document conversion plugin: filename/content/metadata search, locate-by-doc_id/name with content reading, topic listing, bulk document upload, document-to-Markdown conversion, image-similarity search, per-document image descriptions written to a sidecar markdown, a deep-research workflow, and a knowledge-graph (Neo4j) layer — ontology inspection, read-only Cypher, and node/relation writes all go through the DocChain API (no Neo4j password needed). Every script-backed capability also ships as a native tool executed in-process; the configuration page keeps switchable docchain environments with per-environment topic selection

bundle.title: DocChain 文档与知识图谱
bundle.description: DocChain 文档检索/上传/转换/图片描述与深度研究，以及知识图谱：查本体结构、执行 Cypher、写操作，全部走 DocChain API（无需 Neo4j 密码）。
